name: Haoliang Huang
intro: I study Robotics, Cognition, Intelligence at the Technical University of Munich (TUM), with a background in Computer Science from the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT). My work spans robot learning, vision-language-action models, 3D perception, and autonomous driving.
focus: I am interested in connecting perception, learning, and control to build robots that can act in the real world. My projects combine hands-on robot deployment with large-scale data pipelines, distributed training, and careful experimental evaluation.

experience.title: AI Intern · Intelligent Vehicle Dynamics Controls
experience.description: Designed and implemented a CAN-based foundation model for vehicle chassis dynamics using large-scale CAN-bus time-series data, with modular interfaces for future vision-language integration. Contributed to large-scale data processing and distributed training on GPU clusters.

experience.title: Student Research Assistant · Cyber-Physical Systems
experience.description: Worked on CommonRoad competition management, competition algorithm design, autonomous-driving AI systems, and data processing.

awards.title: ManipArena Real-Robot Manipulation Challenge
awards.description: Developed an AI agent + VLA framework for general-purpose embodied manipulation.

awards.title: Category-Level Object Pose Estimation in the Wild
awards.description: Integrated GCEPose with DINOv3 and trained on Omni6DPose and PACE for category-level 6D object pose estimation.

awards.title: CommonRoad AI Programming Prize Challenge
awards.description: Designed a search-based motion planner for autonomous vehicles in CommonRoad scenarios.

projects.title: Semantic-Aware 3D Reconstruction
projects.label: 3D vision
projects.description: Integrated and benchmarked RaySt3R, VGGT, and VolSplat for semantic-aware 3D reconstruction. Contributed to model components and refinement, and led Slurm-based distributed training, large-scale HPC experiments, and scalable data generation pipelines.

projects.title: Whole-Body Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
projects.label: Robot learning
projects.description: Developed a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for the Booster T1 humanoid. Combined low-level motor skills with high-level, vision-integrated interaction policies for coordinated locomotion and manipulation in complex environments.

projects.title: π₀ Deployment & Real-World Benchmarking
projects.label: Embodied AI
projects.description: Deployed π₀ on LeRobot SO-101 and Franka robots. Built custom real-world datasets and designed experiments to evaluate vision-language-action policies in real scenes.

projects.title: Open-Vocabulary 6D Object Pose Estimation
projects.label: 3D vision
projects.description: Built a zero-shot pipeline for unseen objects by combining Grounded-SAM-2 for open-vocabulary segmentation, InstantMesh / Trellis / Hunyuan3D for single-image 3D reconstruction, and Any6D for pose estimation.

projects.title: Safe Reinforcement Learning for Manipulation
projects.label: Robot learning
projects.description: Developed a safe RL-driven control model for a KUKA LBR iiwa 14 robotic arm. Integrated continual learning and domain randomization to address sim-to-real transfer in robotic manipulation.

projects.title: Quantized Large Language Models
projects.label: Machine learning
projects.description: Explored 1-bit and 1.58-bit networks, applying quantization to BERT and LLaMA for text classification and evaluating model performance.

projects.title: Variational Autoencoders for Image Generation
projects.label: Generative models
projects.description: Explored and compared VAE, conditional VAE, and Gaussian Process Prior VAE architectures, with a focus on portrait generation.

projects.title: Benchmarking Inverse Kinematics Algorithms
projects.label: Robot control
projects.description: Benchmarked Cartesian-space controllers and open-source inverse kinematics algorithms for the Franka Emika robot. Worked with robotic manipulation platforms, controller systems, and MuJoCo.

projects.title: Interactive Robot Learning
projects.label: Robot learning
projects.description: Modeled Franka Emika robotic arms in MuJoCo and Blender, and explored learning from demonstration and movement primitives for robot interaction.

projects.title: An Experimental Platform for Outlier Data
projects.label: Software systems
projects.description: Developed a Django web application as an experimental framework for detecting and generating outlying data in high-dimensional databases.

projects.title: Mobile Robots Competition
projects.label: Mobile robotics
projects.description: Programmed a LEGO robot to navigate a complex course, integrating multiple sensors and designing PID controllers for navigation.

projects.title: CNN-Based Traffic Surveys from Drone Video
projects.label: Computer vision
projects.description: Annotated drone videos to build an object-detection dataset. Trained Faster R-CNN and YOLO v3, v4, and v5 with transfer learning, and compared detection performance for traffic surveys.

education.detail: Final grade: 2.1 · Completed in three years
Studied in parallel with the B.Sc. in Computer Science
